text:
incident-bot: PagerDuty alert fired: PD-74291 severity P1 -> multiple AZ7 fabric nodes reporting NIC flaps and rapid instance evictions. Auto-retry loops observed. @sre-oncall-1 page generated. https://pd.example.com/incidents/74291 :rotating_light:

pagerduty-bot: Incident PD-74291 created by monitoring. Symptoms: increased 502s, request queue growth, autoscaler failing to rebalance. Affected region: eu-west-az7.

sre-oncall-1: Acked. I'm on it. Starting triage — pulling up fabric/node health and autoscaler logs.

sre-oncall-1: Quick note — seeing repeated kernel-level NIC flaps on nic0 across 3 nodes (az7-rackB-*) at ~12:34 UTC. Evictions triggered; control plane autoscaler started scale-up but many pods never reached Ready.

eng-runtime-lead: +1 seeing the same from our side. KPIs: 95th latency spiking, token drop errors for some long-running /generate streams. Sending traffic to fallback routing now.

sre-oncall-1: Mitigation plan step 1: isolate flaky nodes from scheduler (cordon + drain) to stop eviction cascade. Step 2: enable regional fallback routing to other AZs for the next 10 minutes. Step 3: request infra to provision hot spare capacity in eu-west-az6.

eng-infra: Provisioning +1 hot pool in az6; ETA ~8m. Sharing a runbook snippet for cordon/drain: ```bash
kubectl cordon node/az7-node-17
kubectl drain node/az7-node-17 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data --force
```

sre-oncall-1: Executed cordon/drain on 3 nodes. Eviction rate dropping but autoscaler still sees pods cycling; scaling events are now stable but we need to verify cache/kv coherence for model shards.

eng-runtime-lead: I'm toggling fallback model variant (lower memory) for high-throughput routes to reduce load on oversized shards. Patching rollout now.

customer-success: FYI - we've opened an incident page with a customer that reported 502 spikes (acct: FathomAnalytics). CS is drafting an outbound to affected customers. Please flag any SLA exposures.

sre-oncall-1: PD ack -> escalation to SRE lead engaged. Handing off active pager to @oncall-backup in 15m once infra scale completes.

oncall-backup: I'm standing by. If the nodes stabilise after the drain and hot pool comes online, recommend we leave fallback routing in place for 30m and then slowly reintroduce AZ7 traffic.

eng-infra: Hot pool in az6 is up (4 x GPU instances). Autoscaler recognized capacity, new pods coming up healthy.

ops-bot: Observability snapshot: error-rate (502) peaked at +12% above baseline at 12:36 UTC, now trending down to +1.5%. Prefixcache miss rate increased 3x during spike.

sre-oncall-1: Confirming: customer-facing errors reduced to baseline. Putting a temporary tag on nodes for further forensic capture. Will leave fallback on 30m and monitor.

eng-runtime-lead: Post-mitigation TODOs: (1) collect NIC firmware & dmesg from cordoned nodes, (2) run kv-cache consistency check across shards, (3) add suppression rules to PD if this reappears within 5m (to avoid alert storms).

customer-success: Draft sent to customers impacted. Notifying enterprise accounts with potential SLA hits.

sre-oncall-1: PD-74291 -> acknowledged and assigned. Escalation to oncall-backup flagged; handoff scheduled at 1768313368 (15m). Leaving channel for updates only. :white_check_mark:

oncall-backup: Took handoff; confirming watches in place. If we see >2% sustained error above baseline or reappearance of NIC flaps, we will trigger controlled failover of remaining AZ7 traffic and open multi-team bridge.

incident-bot: PD-74291 status update: acknowledged -> partial mitigation -> monitor. Next update in 10m or on significant state change.

sre-oncall-1: Follow-ups: file infra ticket for network firmware and investigate load patterns causing fabric energy/queue pressure. Adding retrospective notes to postmortem template.

eng-runtime-lead: Added a temporary routing rule to favor az6/az5 for model-heavy routes. Observability confirms lower tail latency.

sre-oncall-1: Closing active mitigation phase. Moving to monitoring phase. Will attach logs, commands executed, and timeline to the PD incident. Thanks all. :heart:

pagerduty-bot: PD-74291 -> status: monitoring. Incident will be auto-escalated if error-rates worsen.

ops-bot: Snapshot logs attached to PD: /mnt/artifacts/pd-74291/ (dmesg, kube-events, autoscaler-events).

sre-oncall-1: End of thread update at 12:52 UTC.
